title: iPhone Duo Says 'Hello' to You Personally
content:
As expected, the iPhone Duo greets you personally if you purchase it from an Apple Store in the United States.

MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris had an in-store pickup reservation for an iPhone Duo at Apple Fifth Avenue in New York today, and the device showed "Hello Aaron" when he turned it on. It is a small but nice touch that demonstrates Apple's attention to detail.
